notes: Image viewer Save & Copy: Save writes the picture to Pictures/DSH Mobile (MediaStore on Android 10+, SAF picker on 8-9) with byte/declared-MIME sniffing so JPEG-named-PNG files save correctly; Copy puts a read-scoped FileProvider URI on the clipboard. Missing cached files re-download and every outcome has a toast. No new permissions. Also includes host search usability fixes (tool-result images no longer starve search; 8s budget, semantic text reads, per-session cap, scanIncomplete/scannedSessions) and host 0.2.7 tool-image attachments.
